name: Quantum Error Management in Practice: A Cross-Stack Benchmark
description: "This dataset accompanies the manuscript \u201cQuantum Error Management in Practice: A Cross-Stack Benchmark.\u201d It provides experimental records from IBM Quantum's ibm_pittsburgh processor and retrospective metadata intended to support transparent inspection and reanalysis of quantum error-management benchmarks.The Sampler experiments evaluate Bernstein\u2013Vazirani, quantum phase estimation, GHZ-state preparation, and randomized mirror circuits, using exact-output or valid-set success probabilities. The Estimator experiments include transverse-field Ising model observables and GHZ-parity experiments. Provider configurations include IBM Runtime baselines and twirling\/readout-mitigation configurations, Q-CTRL Performance Management, and Qedma QESEM for Estimator workloads. The archive includes additional widths and configurations beyond those selected for the manuscript; it should not be treated as one uniform experimental protocol.The release contains 114 original experiment JSON files, metadata folders for 148 distinct jobs (98 Runtime jobs and 50 Function jobs), 40 deduplicated historical backend-property snapshots, and an index linking the records. The 114 parent experiment jobs comprise 64 direct Runtime jobs and 50 Function jobs; 34 additional Runtime jobs were discovered as Function children. Original experiment records retain counts or probability summaries, expectation values, reference values, and provider-returned information as available.
